zh.topic_title: Beijing bolsters South China Sea push with new island runway: analysts

en.topic_title: Beijing bolsters South China Sea push with new island runway: analysts
en.topic_summary:
China is building a runway on another island in the disputed South China Sea that could significantly strengthen its military footprint in the strategic waterway, according to experts and satellite images seen by AFP.



This handout satellite image taken by Planet Labs PBC on October 17, 2026 shows the foundations of a harbour on the disputed Antelope Reef in the Paracel Islands in the South China Sea. Photo: Planet Labs/AFP.
